about: Disagreements between a rule and Microsoft Learn's move-support page that a person reviewed and decided to keep. scripts/refresh-rules-from-learn.mjs reads this file and shows each one in the weekly report with its reason, apart from new disagreements. An entry matches one rule field with one pair of values (what the rule says, what Learn says); when either changes, the entry stops matching and the row is reported as new. Add an entry only after checking the row against Learn, and link where it was decided.
